p: bowed not: The Persians custom was to kneel down and reverence their kings, and such as he anointed in chief authority, which Mordecai would not do to this ambitious and proud man.
told Haman: Thus we see that there is no one so wicked but they have their flatterers to accuse the godly.
Nisan: Which contains part of March and part of April.
before Haman from day to day: To know what month and day would be good to attempt this thing, that it might be successful: but God disappointed their lots and expectations.
Adar: Containing part of February and part of March.

king's laws: These are the two arguments which commonly the worldlings and the wicked use toward princes against the godly, that is, the contempt of their laws and diminishing of their profit without concern as to whether God is pleased or displeased.
city Shushan was perplexed: That is, the Jews that were in Shushan.
